## SeaRates at Valencia Digital Summit 2025

Inside Valencia's City of Arts and Sciences, fifteen thousand people gathered under high white arches to figure out where global trade goes next.

Valencia Digital Summit 2025 (VDS25) took place on October 22-23, 2025 in Spain. More than 15,000 participants attended the event. The crowd included 1,500 startups alongside 500 industry leaders. Across two days of sessions, attendees discussed artificial intelligence, supply chain management, Industry 5.0, and green technology.

The summit gave SeaRates space to show how software simplifies supply chain operations. The team visited startup exhibitions and participated in technical discussions. They also met with regional partners and industry innovators. Valeriya Guliy represented SeaRates at VDS25 and published her reflections on LinkedIn after the conference.

## Digital Tools for Global Trade

Modern shipping demands reliable data. Within a unified smart logistics ecosystem, SeaRates presented four core tools built for daily freight management:

* Logistics Explorer handles freight calculation and real-time booking.
* Route Planner optimizes linear and multimodal routes.
* Ship Schedules manages sailing timeline schedules.
* Tracking System functions as an application for monitoring all cargo types.

These solutions deliver supply chain visibility and real-time freight tracking across international trade lanes. They provide practical tools to help logisticians solve complex shipping problems.

## Observations from VDS25

Sessions at VDS25 pointed to significant shifts in how cargo moves. Manual processes continue to slow down supply chains, making automation essential. Automation and data visibility give freight companies needed flexibility. Smart software integrations further help businesses stay resilient in uncertain global markets.

Environmental priorities also drove conversation. Innovation is the child of sustainability, as speakers noted during technical panels. Building sustainable operations remains a long process, but the industry needs practical green logistics solutions now.

Growth in this sector relies heavily on collaboration. The summit demonstrated that breakthroughs happen through alliances. Freight forwarders work directly with tech innovators and logistics providers. Forward-thinking enterprises work alongside them.

## Future Outlook
